title: Sounds in focus
text: : I'll draw the Earth and colour it green and blue.
You will also make a poster for Earth Day in groups. What will each group member do?
Make your poster for Earth Day in groups. Then talk about it in class.
1 Listen to the sentence from the story and read.
Will you draw or write on the poster?
2 Listen to the rhyme and chant along. Then find more words.
We're all born on the Earth.
Short or tall, old or young.
